name: Touch
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the elemental, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.
